description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Cryptic Trilobite from your library.
Repeat.
